import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = json.dumps({
  "loggingEnabled": True
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("PATCH", "/proxy/network/integration/v1/sites/{siteId}/firewall/policies/{firewallPolicyId}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Patch Firewall Policy
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.network:
    path: "/v1/sites/{siteId}/firewall/policies/{firewallPolicyId}"
    method: PATCH
    body:
      loggingEnabled: true
  register: result

- debug:
    var: result.data
